production.rationale: One processing unit per 10 seconds; this is an 80% utilization target for a module-free assembling machine 3 at the normal 2.1.24 recipe speed, with ingredient rates balanced exactly to the installed recipe.

design.beltLayout: One short, eastbound yellow-belt route for each item input; the native feeder extends each route west during the test.
design.undergroundBelts: Not needed: each item route reaches its dedicated inserter directly.
design.fluidLayout: Two contiguous west-to-east pipes from the single west acid handoff to the recipe machine.
design.output: One fast inserter into one unbarred east-side passive-provider chest.
design.displays: Always-visible item/fluid icon and text beside each input and output.
